title: Pulse relying-party trust-root pin v1
description: Out-of-band verifier configuration. It must be provisioned independently of the evidence bundle and protected by deployment controls. It pins one Ed25519 root key and one exact current trust-policy snapshot; root rotation is not supported by this v1 pin.

root_public_key_hex.description: Ed25519 root public key. root_key_id must equal sha256:<lowercase SHA-256 of these 32 bytes>.

policy_sha256.description: Exact digest of the trust-policy file bytes; this makes the accepted current snapshot explicit and prevents replay of an older signed policy.
